author: maintainer-agent

patch.value:
## Latent relationships available today
Pull-request lanes record which change closed which items, in history messages and in evidence comments. Nightly failures record which leg produced which issue. Linked files record which items share a source region. Linked test runs record which item a run verified. Scanner imports record which finding produced which triage batch. All of it is already immutable and none of it is a graph edge.

## Derivation, not inference
Every edge this wave writes must trace to a specific immutable record. Similarity, co-occurrence, and title heuristics are out of scope — those produce plausible edges, and a plausible edge is worse than a missing one because it survives review by looking reasonable.

## Ordering
Runs after the baseline and the legacy hygiene batch so it is not writing edges into a structure that is about to be cleaned. Feeds the reachability profile, which can then measure real depth rather than depth inflated by noise.

## Boundary
No generic density target. No automatic edge whose source and confidence cannot be explained.
Graph wave: reconstruct evidence, incident, release, and package relationships from immutable history and linked resources

A reproducible extractor derives candidate edges from history messages, evidence comments, linked files, and linked test runs, emitting source and confidence for each; Only candidates whose source and confidence can be stated are materialised; unexplainable candidates are logged to an uncertainty ledger, never written; Derived edges carry the derivation source so a later correction can supersede rather than silently overwrite; Terminal items are touched only inside a dedicated changelog-safe batch, with the changelog effect measured and regenerated last; Re-running the extractor is idempotent: no duplicate edges, no timestamp churn on unchanged items
Relationships that already exist implicitly in history and linked artifacts become explicit typed edges

The workspace already records which pull request closed which item, which nightly failure produced which issue, which release shipped which change, and which file each item touched — but only as prose in history messages and comments, where no graph algorithm can reach it.
Roughly doubles the semantic edge supply without a single judgement call, because every edge is derived from an immutable record rather than inferred from similarity.
Typed verifies, discovered_from, incident_from, and release-association edges are materialised from history entries, linked files, and evidence comments, each carrying its derivation source.
The reconstruction wave is declared in the plan strategy but has no task, and the raw material is already immutable — derivation is reproducible and safe to re-run, unlike judgement-based enrichment.
